title: Distinct Numbers in Each Subarray
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, determine the count of distinct elements in each subarray of size k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, determine the count of distinct elements in each subarray of size k. Return an array where each element represents the distinct count for the corresponding subarray.
constraints: k is between one and nums length.
Return the number of distinct values in every contiguous window of length k.
hints: Maintain counts for exactly the current window.
Add the incoming value and remove the value k positions behind.
Delete a key when its count reaches zero; append the map size after the first full window.
The map contains precisely values with positive multiplicity in each window, so its size is the required distinct count.
editorial: The map contains precisely values with positive multiplicity in each window, so its size is the required distinct count.
